title: Physics on a noncommutative space with topology is still to be done

statements.text: Kauffman states that it remains to go from the abstract algebraic setting to physics on a noncommutative space that is topological, continuum or combinatorial, since topology is needed for connectivity, and to compare the results with teleparallel and metric affine gravity.
